# helm-dwpk

> Helm chart for dwpk (development workspace platform for Kubernetes): a Go
> operator (manager), an SSH gateway, and a marketplace web UI, deployed
> together as one release. CRDs: UserSpace, Workspace, WorkspaceImage.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/devops-ia/helm-dwpk/blob/main/README.md): repo overview, repository/OCI install instructions
- [Chart README](https://github.com/devops-ia/helm-dwpk/blob/main/charts/dwpk/README.md): full values reference, quick start, exposing the UI, admin bootstrap
- [Examples README](https://github.com/devops-ia/helm-dwpk/blob/main/charts/dwpk/examples/README.md): example CRs and values files
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/devops-ia/helm-dwpk/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute
- [TESTING](https://github.com/devops-ia/helm-dwpk/blob/main/TESTING.md): how to test the chart
